correctness.rationale: Counting distinct factors by their run forms gives one empty factor, the two maximal monochromatic ranges, a union of two rectangles for 01 with the overlap subtracted, bc for 10, and ac+bd for three-run factors. All of these are palindrome pairs. For a four-run factor 0^i1^b0^c1^j a qualifying split must either use the initial zero run alone with j=b, or use a three-run first palindrome that ends precisely at the end of the third run with i=c. Their overlap contributes just once. For the bound write X=(n^2+2n)/3. In the region c<=a, b<=d the simplified product is at most (n+2)^2/4. In the opposite region, with s=b+c and t=a+d, use bc<=s^2/4 and ad>=t−1 and complete the square to get (n^2+n+10)/3. In the mixed region c<=a, b>d, set t=a+c, s=n−t and use P=1+n+st+c(t−1−c)+d(s−t−d). If s<=t the last term is at most s−t−1, giving (n^2+n+7)/3 after optimizing in t; if s>t complete both squares and use 2<=t<n/2, giving 5n^2/16+3n/4+5/4. Reversal followed by complement gives the remaining region. These bounds are <=X for n>=10, so P<L. For n=4..9 the independently enumerated maxima are 8,12,16,21,27,33, all strictly below L. The three-run count 1+max(x,z)+y+xy+yz+xz gives L in the three indicated residue classes. The independent conjugacy-based replay checked 1001 four-run words and the three-run witnesses for n=4..14.
residual_risks: The replay checks finitely many lengths; the case inequalities, not extrapolation, handle n>=10. No unrestricted maximum or assertion about more than four runs is established.
